pages.text: The Codex tracks your progress in real time. Three chat commands show exactly where you stand — type them any time:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex balance$() — your token pool.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex bosses$() — your boss-rush clear.$(li)$(bold)/icraft codex submit$() — bank materials into tokens.$(br2)$(note)The book cannot print live numbers — these commands report them in chat.$()

pages.title: Your Token Balance
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex balance$()$(br2)Lists your held tokens against each tier's threshold — $(t2)500$() / $(t3)1000$() / $(t4)2000$() — and which tier your bulk metals currently mint toward. When a pool reaches its threshold the Codex spends it and grants the next tier automatically.$(br2)Full table: $(l:icraft:progression/tier_unlock_checklist)Tier Targets$(/l).

pages.title: The Boss Rush
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex bosses$()$(br2)Shows, per tier, how many of that tier's bosses you have cleared and the share you need — $(t2)80%$() / $(t3)90%$() / $(t4)100%$(). Clearing the share auto-advances you, no tokens required.$(br2)Every boss and miniboss kill also feeds the token pool, so the two routes stack.

pages.title: Banking Materials
pages.text: $(bold)/icraft codex submit$() converts the eligible materials you carry into tokens — capped per material, lossless.$(br2)$(li)$(bold)submit engineering$() — Create / Thermal / Mekanism metals and machines.$(li)$(bold)submit magic$() — Botania / Ars / Occultism reagents and apparatus.$(br2)Or click $(bold)Submit$() in the Engineering and Magic Crafting quest groups — same cap-safe banking, one click. Exploration and Combat need no submit; they mint as you play.
